_说明: 见证者点击气泡台词文件：格式=对象 {_说明, lines}，lines=字符串数组（句子池，句数不限）。
第五关现代终局语境：文本不绑定任何具体外貌与服饰，通用适配所有皮肤形象；调性温柔坚定，安慰主角不必因离别分心，引导主角将心神专注在眼前的榫卯与七千年的匠心之上。
抽取与播放归 Y5 波（洗牌袋整轮不重复；池空/缺文件不弹+告警）。
英文字段（2026-11-01 增补）：可选「lines_en」（与 lines 逐条等长、按句一一对应）；lines_en 缺失或缺省时回退显示中文 lines，既有中文字段一律不动。
lines: 看我作甚？看手里的木头！只要这门手艺在，咱们就永远都在。
别分心，现在的你已经不需要为离别感伤，也不用为锐眼耗费力气了，放手去合上它！
手别抖。七千年的时光都静静淌在你的凿痕里呢，沉住气，慢慢收尾。
好啦，别总拿眼神瞟我。我这不是还在边上好好陪着你嘛，快拼你的！
‘锐眼’如今已是你的本能了。闭上眼，木料该往哪儿转、卯眼该往哪儿咬，你心里全清楚。
天下没有不散的筵席，但在时间的循环里，我们迟早还会再相遇的。
把心沉进木料里去。当年先民在水边构木为巢时，眼里也唯有这一榫一卯。
累了？歇一口气也无妨。这最后一件活儿，值得你最耐心、最郑重地去对待。
转一转视角，瞧瞧这浑然天成的结构。现代的技术再先进，这一咬一合的灵魂，终究是你的双手赋予的。
不要怕前路未知的强敌。能把这沉甸甸的千年非遗扛起来的人，天底下还有什么难得倒你？
衣橱里的衣裳你若是喜欢，往后就留着穿。不过眼下嘛，还是专心把这最后一关拿下！
听听这木头接合的脆响……真好听啊。这是我陪你走过九十九程里，听过最动人的声音。
哪怕时间重置千百次，我也绝不会认错你下刀时这专注的模样。
专心致志，方得始终。把这最后一道榫头推进去吧，我在终点看着你呢！
去吧，去解开所有的谜团，去打破背后的枷锁，去见那些你在未来拼尽全力想要守护的人。
落锤吧，大匠——为这走过了七千年的旅途，画上最圆满的句号！
lines_en: Why look at me? Look at the wood in your hands! While this craft endures, we endure with it.
Don't be distracted. You no longer need mourn a parting, nor spend strength on the Keen Eye—go and close that joint!
Steady those hands. Seven thousand years run quietly in your chisel marks—hold your breath, and finish slowly.
All right, stop glancing at me. Am I not still here beside you, safe and sound? Back to your piecing!
The Keen Eye is instinct now. Close your eyes—where the timber should turn, where the mortise should bite, you know it all.
No feast under heaven lasts forever—but in the circle of time, we will meet again, sooner or later.
Sink your heart into the timber. When the ancestors framed wood into nests by the water, their eyes held only this—one tenon, one mortise.
Tired? A breath's rest does no harm. This final piece deserves your fullest patience and your most solemn care.
Turn the view—look how the structure was born whole. However advanced modern technique grows, the soul of this bite and clasp was given by your two hands.
Fear no unknown foe on the road ahead. One who can shoulder this weighty thousand-year heritage—what under heaven could ever stop you?
If you like the outfits in the Wardrobe, keep them for the days ahead. But for now—focus, and take this final level!
Listen to that crisp ring of wood meeting wood... how lovely. Of all ninety-nine journeys I have walked with you, it is the most moving sound I've heard.
Even if time were reset a thousand times over, I could never mistake that focused face of yours when the blade goes in.
Whole heart, whole will—that is how endings are kept true. Push this last tenon home; I'll be watching at the finish!
Go—untangle every mystery, break the chains at your back, and meet the people you will give everything to protect in the future.
Strike the hammer, master builder—and bring this seven-thousand-year journey to its most perfect close!
